name: SEO and AEO Desk
description: Runs the search desk loop an agency sells: a keyword and question map, a content brief per target, and a page audit for classic search (SEO) and AI answer engines (AEO). Produces a keyword map, ready-to-write briefs and a prioritised fix list tied to evidence. Use when the user asks for keyword research, a content brief, an SEO or AEO audit, why a page does not rank or is not cited by AI answers, or a search plan for a site or client. Do NOT use for writing the finished article (use seo-blog-post), paid search ads, or local listings and reviews (use local search skills).
